rationale: This record is a published book review of an edited volume on general public policy and public administration in Central and Eastern Europe. It fails Criterion 1 (no household or community water or sanitation service topic), Criterion 2 narrow (no water/sanitation legal or administrative access mechanism), Criterion 3 (book review rather than primary empirical research or a systematic review), and Criterion 4 (no water or sanitation access outcomes).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the record is a non-empirical book review on general public policy and public administration in Central and Eastern Europe with no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access.
